name: io.github.usainbluntmx/sekisho-mcp
title: Sekisho MCP
description: Lets any MCP client pay x402 tools in USDC on Avalanche, with per-call and 24 h caps.

environmentVariables.name: SEKISHO_MCP_URL
environmentVariables.description: Remote paid MCP server (Streamable HTTP), e.g. https://sekisho-api.zerotwolabs.xyz/mcp

environmentVariables.name: SEKISHO_MAX_PER_DAY
environmentVariables.description: Max USDC in any 24 h window

environmentVariables.name: SEKISHO_PAYER_KEY_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Path to the payer private key file (mode 600). Never put the key itself in config.
